text:
A thin metal foil is placed in a vacuum. α-particles are fired at the foil and most go straight
through. A very small proportion of the α-particles are deflected through large angles.
What does this provide evidence for?
α-particles are very small.
A
B
There are negative electrons in each atom.
C
There is a tiny nucleus in each atom.
D
There are neutrons in each atom.

options.label: B
options.text: There are negative electrons in each atom.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a tiny nucleus in each atom.

options.label: D
options.text: There are neutrons in each atom.
